title: Concept: Access-Control-Allow-Origin names more than one origin
description: A multi-origin Access-Control-Allow-Origin is never a valid grant, so browsers reject it and the intended cross-origin access stops working while the header still looks permissive.
risk: Cross-origin clients fail closed in the browser while non-browser consumers of the header may read it as an allow-list; LOW because the browser outcome is denial rather than exposure.
